name: loopway
description: LoopWay / Vlora — land transport & freight marketplace. UI-only workspace (marketing site + B2B company portal + Admin portal).

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/b2b && npm run build -w apps/admin && npm run build -w apps/site
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/b2b && npm run lint -w apps/admin && npm run lint -w apps/site
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/b2b/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/site/tsconfig.json --noEmit
